quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration: two end customers each represented more than 10% of total revenue in each of the last three years. Sales to one end customer represented 16%, 15% and 21% of total revenue, and sales to the other end customer 26%, 20% and 18%, for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023. The end customers are not named (XBRL tags them Reseller A and Reseller B).
Revenue by product line for fiscal year 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31: Product $7.58B (+28.8% YoY vs $5.88B), Service $1.43B (+27.7% YoY vs $1.12B).
